name: Spinach Moong Soup
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) split yellow moong dal, rinsed
Lemon juice, salt and black pepper
steps: Pressure-cook or simmer the moong dal with turmeric and the water for 15–20 minutes until completely soft.
In a separate pot, heat the oil, add cumin and garlic and let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, then add the spinach and wilt for 2 minutes.
Combine with the dal and blend until smooth.
Reheat, adjust the thickness with hot water, and finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
note: Moong dal is among the easiest pulses to digest, which makes this a gentle high-protein soup.
